artwork.title: Artwork Upload
artwork.formats: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, TIFF, EPS · max 20 MB
artwork.canvas_label: Print template preview. Use arrow keys to move the artwork, plus and minus to scale.
artwork.drag_hint: Drag the artwork (or use arrow keys) to position it. Keep text inside the blue line; everything past the red line is trimmed.
artwork.production_note: Your project goes into production once artwork is submitted and the purchase is completed. Please review the warnings before adding to cart.
artwork.bad_format: {name} isn't accepted for this product. Use {formats}.
artwork.too_large: {name} is {size} MB; the limit is {max} MB.
artwork.dpi_low: Resolution is {dpi} DPI at print size. {min} DPI is recommended; it may print soft.
artwork.dpi_too_low: Resolution is only {dpi} DPI at print size (minimum 150, {min} recommended). Upload a larger file.
artwork.aspect: Artwork aspect ratio ({ar}) differs from the template ({tr}); some art will be cropped or need repositioning.
artwork.rgb: RGB file: colours will be converted to CMYK for print and may shift slightly.
artwork.pdf_size: PDF page is {w}" x {h}"; expected {tw}" x {th}" (trim + bleed).
artwork.pdf_no_bleed: PDF is trim size with no bleed. Add {bleed}" bleed on each side to avoid white edges.
artwork.pdf_ok: PDF page size {w}" x {h}" matches trim + bleed.
artwork.pdf_pages: PDF has {pages} pages; this product prints {sides} side(s).
artwork.pdf_failed: Couldn't read {name} for preview; it will still be attached and checked by our team.
artwork.no_preview: {name} can't be previewed in the browser. Only file type and size were checked; our team will review it.
artwork.no_template: Select a size to see the print template.
artwork.template: Trim {w}" x {h}" · with bleed {bw}" x {bh}" · {dpi} DPI recommended
artwork.blocked: Fix the errors in your artwork before adding to cart.
artwork.confirm_needed: Review the preflight warnings and tick “I understand, print as is”.
artwork.later_help: After checkout, email your files to shopprintr@gmail.com with your order number in the subject. Production starts once we receive them.
artwork.later_confirm: I'll email my files to shopprintr@gmail.com with my order number
artwork.qa_help: A designer on our team checks and fixes your files (size, bleed, resolution, colour) before printing.
artwork.die_cut: Die-cut product: include a cut path (a vector outline on its own layer or spot colour named CutContour), or our team will create one.
artwork.folds: Folded product with {n} panels: keep text away from the purple fold lines.
artwork.apparel: Apparel: the blue box is the maximum print area (no bleed). Your art is placed inside it.
artwork.large_format: Large format: {dpi} DPI at full size is enough for viewing distance.
artwork.email_required: Confirm you'll email your files with your order number.
artwork.qa_recommended: We recommend adding Pre-flight & designer QA when sending files later.
artwork.pages_mismatch: PDF has {pages} pages; this product expects {expected}.

artwork_dropoff.step_1: Find your order number (e.g. #1234) in your confirmation email.
artwork_dropoff.step_3: Put the order number in the subject, e.g. “Order #1234”. One email per order; name files by side (front/back).
artwork_dropoff.step_4: We'll reply within one business day if anything needs fixing. Production starts once the files are approved.
artwork_dropoff.large_files: Files over 20 MB: send a WeTransfer, Google Drive or Dropbox link in the email instead of attaching.
artwork_dropoff.mail_body:
